name: youtube-mcp
description: Search YouTube, manage your channel and read your analytics. Every change to your account is previewed and needs your approval first.

settings.name: YouTube Data API key
settings.description: Your YouTube Data API v3 key. Enough for the public tools.

settings.name: OAuth client JSON path (optional)
settings.description: Absolute path to the Desktop OAuth client JSON. Only needed for account and creator tools.

settings.name: Profile name (optional)
settings.description: A name you choose, for example creator-main. Only needed for creator tools.

settings.name: Channel ID (optional)
settings.description: Your YouTube channel ID, starting with UC. Only needed for creator tools.

settings.name: State directory (optional)
settings.description: Where local state (OAuth token, approvals, local history database) lives. Leave empty to use ~/.youtube-mcp.
